title: Questions 161-163 refer to the following information.
passage_1:
Kingsley Event Hire

Kingsley Event Hire is the leading supplier of equipment for outdoor events such as concerts and festivals. We can provide heavy-duty marquees, stages, lighting rigs, and more. – [1] –. Our engineering team carries out a full inspection before every installation. – [2] –. Although we are based in Leeds, we have branches in Sheffield and Hull so that we can serve the whole of the north efficiently.

To help our clients further, we have introduced a new benefit. – [3] –. Customers who hire a stage and at least three marquees for a single event qualify for a 12 percent reduction on the whole order. We also offer a weather guarantee to every client, allowing them to move their booking without paying extra fees in the event of severe weather. – [4] –.

Interested organizers should send us their event dates and details at least two months in advance.
